cases.name: brotli-installed-code-omits-reversed-head-bit
cases.new: let next_reversed = 2 * reversed + if remaining == 1 { bit } else { 0 };
cases.semantics: The original mutation replaced every recursive non-base combine with rest. It preserves width-one behavior and leaves only the original most-significant bit as 0/1 for larger widths. The iterative replacement omits every non-base combine bit and retains exactly the final original most-significant bit. Existing assertions remain unchanged.

cases.name: brotli-b3b-context-need-input-does-not-suspend
cases.semantics: Only the NeedInput result becomes continued progress. Reached source counters, proof statements, queue writes, and return receipt remain unchanged.

cases.name: brotli-b3b-context-rle-writes-one
cases.old:
crate::brotli_prefix::write_next_context_entry(
                                    workspace, window_bytes, kind, active_len,
                                    initialized, 0, num_trees)
cases.new:
crate::brotli_prefix::write_next_context_entry(
                                    workspace, window_bytes, kind, active_len,
                                    initialized, 1, num_trees)
cases.semantics: Only the repeat-run context cell value changes from zero to one. Actual child invocation, error handling, child receipt capture, and receipt propagation remain unchanged.

cases.name: brotli-b3b-context-bit-truncation-needs-input
cases.semantics: Only the terminal truncated-input result becomes NeedInput. The unchanged branch refinement assertion, reached counters, and actual receipt remain.

cases.name: brotli-b3b-tree-field-truncation-needs-input
cases.semantics: Only CodeDescriptionDecoder's returned Truncated status becomes NeedInput. Its stored Failed phase, all assertions, and actual source_reads receipt remain unchanged. MetaBlockDecoder's overload is not selected.
